name: # The accent-paradigm inventory (3.0). Built in: a (the lemma's stem vowel
# everywhere), b (the ending everywhere; a participle on the stem). Every
# other paradigm is a shape `cargo xtask census stress` showed on
# 2026-09-05, named, with an exemplar and the census's count at naming; a
# lexeme's stress column names one and keeps an exception list only where
# none fits. Places: S stem, E ending, L last stem vowel, F last vowel of
# the word. Keys: a cell, sg/du/pl, a block (part, long.comp), a tense
# nouns: the plural cells that go to the ending, the retractions
# adjectives: the short forms' end stress, the comparative's suffix
# verbs: the present's retraction (вожꙋ̀, во́диши), the second plural's final syllable, the participle types, the aorist's third plural
# pronouns: the oblique singular on the ending's last vowel

# verbs, 3.0 Part 1 (V3.0-PROMPT.md): the place P — the present passive participle's masculine short nominative retracts to the vowel before -им-/-ем- (и҆зго́нимъ, возревнꙋ́емъ), the present active participle's short and long m/n nominative to the vowel before -ѧ-/-ющ- (благовѣствꙋ́ѧ, почествꙋ́ющїй); and the shapes without P the census repeated (the infinitive on the stem, the second plural on the ending's first vowel, the aorist's second and third singular on the stem, the past passive short feminine and genitive on the ending)

# the whole present-participle block on P: the -ova- verbs stressed on -ва́- (благовѣствꙋ́ѧ, благовѣствꙋ́ющїй: the class contracted the lemma's vowel away), and the retracting present's participles (благохва́лѧщїй beside благохва́лиши)

# adjectives, 3.0 Part 1 step 3: the adverb cell's accent against the adjective's (the census over the adv-of= lines: 12 on the stem of an end-stressed adjective, 6 on the ending of a stem-stressed one)
